_comment: Non-secret deploy config, checked into git. Used by backend/scripts/deploy.mjs as a second factor so a migration can never land on the wrong Supabase project, even if an .env file gets repointed by accident.

staging.note: Disposable test project. deploy.mjs is the ONLY environment this script will ever open a live database connection to.

production.note: This app's production Supabase project is never given a live connection by this script, by design. `deploy.mjs migrate --env production` only reads the migrations/ directory and writes a single combined .sql bundle for a human to paste into the Supabase SQL Editor themselves. There is no --force / --apply escape hatch for production in this script.
